paper.title_en: Evolution of Magnetism in Ce$_4$Ge$_7$ under Magnetic Field and Pressure
paper.abstract_en: We report the magnetic and transport properties of single-crystalline Ce$_4$Ge$_7$, which crystallizes in a non-centrosymmetric orthorhombic structure (space group C222$_1$). It undergoes an antiferromagnetic transition at $T_N$ = 7.3 K. When a magnetic field is applied along the $b$-axis, a metamagnetic transition occurs at 1.3 T (at 2 K). Correspondingly, this transition gives rise to an anomalous Hall effect, which is dominated by the intrinsic Karplus-Luttinger mechanism. Under hydrostatic pressure, $T_N$ of Ce$_4$Ge$_7$ initially increases slightly and is then gradually suppressed. For pressures above $P_c$ = 10.2 GPa, no magnetic order is observed. The divergence of the $A$ coefficient, the maximum of the residual resistivity, and the non-Fermi liquid behavior around $P_c$ indicate the possible existence of an antiferromagnetic quantum critical point in Ce$_4$Ge$_7$.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文报道了非中心对称Ce4Ge7单晶的磁性、输运、磁场诱导变磁转变与反常霍尔效应，以及静水压下的反铁磁量子临界点迹象（非费米液体行为），属于强关联电子/量子临界体系，对凝聚态全息方法有潜在参考价值，故建议点入阅读。
decision.title_zh: Ce$_4$Ge$_7$中磁性在磁场与压力下的演化
decision.abstract_zh: 我们报道了单晶Ce$_4$Ge$_7$的磁性与输运性质，该材料结晶于非中心对称的正交结构（空间群C222$_1$）。它在$T_N$ = 7.3 K发生反铁磁转变。当沿$b$轴施加磁场时，在1.3 T（2 K下）出现变磁转变。相应地，该转变引起反常霍尔效应，该效应由本征的Karplus-Luttinger机制主导。在静水压下，Ce$_4$Ge$_7$的$T_N$先略微增加，随后逐渐被抑制。对于高于$P_c$ = 10.2 GPa的压力，未观察到磁有序。$A$系数的发散、剩余电阻率的最大值以及$P_c$附近的非费米液体行为表明，Ce$_4$Ge$_7$中可能存在反铁磁量子临界点。
